subtitle: Neighborhood coffee bar
intro: Espresso roasted in small lots, a short pastry list, and a room quiet enough to stay awhile.
about: Hearth & Rye is a single room on Pine Street. We roast two days a week, bake what we can sell in a morning, and leave the rest of the day unhurried.

offerings.title: House espresso
offerings.detail: Chocolate, citrus, and a clean finish. Served as a short or long pull.

offerings.title: Batch filter
offerings.detail: One coffee on the brew bar each morning, changed when the pot runs out.

offerings.title: Oat cortado
offerings.detail: Equal parts espresso and steamed oat milk, lightly sweet.

offerings.title: Morning bun
offerings.detail: Laminated dough, orange sugar, baked before open.
